lead.name: Camila Sales
lead.goals: Nicholas is turning one. Keep the space theme and make the nursery safer and calmer.
lead.must_stay: Six-drawer dresser, crib, rocker, space-themed wall decor

deliverable.intro: Hi Camila. Nicholas is turning one, and this refresh keeps the nursery you already have while making the floor safer and the dresser easier to use every day.
needs: Anchor the dresser so it cannot tip
Keep a clear floor path for a newly mobile toddler
Warm the window without a portable heater

zones.title: Safe Sleep Zone
zones.desc: Crib stays clear of cords and loose bedding.

zones.title: Diaper & Dress Zone
zones.desc: The six-drawer dresser stays. Wipes, diapers, and clothes live in the existing drawers, including the bottom drawer for bulky bedding.

zones.title: Play & Movement Zone
zones.desc: Clear floor path from the door through the center of the room, between the dresser and the crib.

zones.title: Comfort & Feed Zone
zones.desc: Rocker stays on the crib wall, farther from the window than the crib.

deliverable.wall_color_note: No paint change — keep the existing wall color from the photo.

shopping_list.name: Basket set to replace dresser drawers

deliverable.budget_note: Total ~$124–$154 for safety anchors and thermal upgrades.
strategy: Replace the dresser drawers with baskets for a cleaner look.
Add large open cubbies beside the crib for toys.
Upgrade curtains with a thermal layer and keep the ones you have.
action_plan: Anchor the six-drawer dresser to the wall before anything else.
Strip the crib to a bare mattress with one fitted sheet.
Install the thermal curtain panels and the door sweep.
deliverable.notes: Windows and room proportions stay ~95% true to your photo.
deliverable.summary: Same nursery, calmer floor, dresser drawers kept.
